test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All peacocks are pigeons.

Some pigeons are pinks.

Some pinks are birds.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some pinks are peacocks.

(II) Some birds are pigeons.

(III) Some peacocks are birds.

options.text: Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9741f75f02a018febe2685d7461de048bc4b1b6e459f77af0f00682cd8f30ac.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some pinks are peacocks. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between pinks and peacocks. Hence, false)

(II) Some birds are pigeons. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between birds and pigeons. Hence, false)

(III) Some peacocks are birds. → Does not follow (There is no definite relation between birds and peacocks. Hence, false)

Hence, '**None of the conclusion follow**' is the correct answer.
